subject: general
question: Which edition of India International Trade Fair (IITF) took place in the year 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**40th**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The 40th edition of India International Trade Fair (IITF) took place in the year 2021.
 
• The India International Trade Fair (IITF) 2021 was inaugurated by the Minister of Commerce and Industry Piyush Goyal on14 November 2021 in New Delhi.
 
• The Fair focuses on the theme "Aatmanirbhar Bharat".
 
• Bihar is the Partner State, while Uttar Pradesh and Jharkhand are the Focus

 States.
 
• Overseas participation is from Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bahrain, Kyrgyzstan, Nepal, Sri Lanka, UAE, Tunisia, and Turkey.
 
• The** first IITF** was held in **1980**, and since then, it has been held every year in **November at Pragati Maidan, New Delhi**.
 
• The 40th edition of IITF, a magnum of the India Trade Promotion Organization(ITPO), represents India in totality as an ideal destination for numerous business and investment opportunities.
